material_known_finding.author: Fable finding F2
material_known_finding.finding: Applicability fields end with a dangling comma/incomplete phrase, and unit 95 contains non-source katakana. Assertions retain content elsewhere, so do not count all five as absent source functions.
examples: or assistance program or head start program, or
in accordance with the federal individuals with disabilities education
this is an age attainment date,
material_known_finding.implication: Consumers cannot treat these applicability fields as complete qualifications. Exact host roundtrip preserves the defects; no host clipping, repair or extraction retry occurred.

fable_contested_findings.title: Deletion/addition asserted from double parentheses without uncertainty
fable_contested_findings.practical_implication: Readers relying on these units take a convention-based interpretation as a source fact. The content of the bracketed text and the authorization sentence are otherwise reported accurately.

fable_contested_findings.title: Eligibility criteria recast as mandatory duties
fable_contested_findings.practical_implication: Force labels overstate directive character. Read as conditions of eligibility, the units are accurate; read as duties, they are not evidenced.

fable_contested_findings.title: Declarative-future allocation language labeled mandatory
fable_contested_findings.practical_implication: Low. Assertions are faithful; only the modality tag presumes a binding reading.

fable_contested_findings.title: Actor inferred for passive accounting duty
fable_contested_findings.practical_implication: Actor assignment is a reasonable inference, not a stated fact. Scope mismatch between lead-in and (e) also bears on UI-07/UI-08.

fable_contested_findings.title: Permissive authorization under a 'must:' lead-in left without uncertainty
fable_contested_findings.practical_implication: Low to medium. The permissive reading is probably right, but the structural tension and scope shift are unflagged.

fable_contested_findings.title: Historical filing described as the thing being amended
fable_contested_findings.practical_implication: Readers should pair 81 with 84 to avoid treating the WSR number as the regulated text.

fable_minor_notes.title: 'or portions of the proposal' omitted from exemption assertions
LEA category equated with named school types
fable_minor_notes.practical_implication: Minor inference; likely correct in domain but not in text.

fable_minor_notes.title: Unflagged source ambiguities
fable_minor_notes.practical_implication: Facts are not wrong; uncertainty coverage is thinner than the source warrants.

requested_contract_dimensions.deadlines: Fable supports units 35,36,44 preserving printed cutoff values and explicitly absent timezone/timeliness basis or absent clock; units 10,34 preserve missing zones for stated clocks. No receipt/postmark or timezone default inferred.
requested_contract_dimensions.rule_vs_filing: Affected WAC target and historical filing/dates are separately present. Fable flags unit 81 wording as contested while unit 84 correctly states the WAC amendment target.
requested_contract_dimensions.atomicity: Fable notes a bundle in unit 37 and other supported grouping notes; retained facts remain present and are not counted as omissions or failed fixed-unit-count expectations.
requested_contract_dimensions.force: Fable treats eligibility-as-duty, future allocation, passive actor assignment and permission under a mandatory lead-in as disputed interpretations/uncertainty issues rather than settled legal errors.
requested_contract_dimensions.qualifications: Known applicability text defects are concentrated in units 88,95,96,98,99; undefined referents/year frames and markup-status/scope tensions remain visible as advisory gaps.
requested_contract_dimensions.source_function_crosswalk: Every non-uncertainty frozen reference entry has a Fable many-to-many mapping. Five funding criteria were initially grouped and now explicitly unpacked by a same-session supplement; no new omission or reference change.

reference_limits: The frozen reference treats the deletion reading of double parentheses as unresolved; a reader applying standard WSR drafting conventions would regard units 94 and 95 as correct. The finding F1 is about evidentiary basis, not likely truth.
The reference's own force labels (declarative future for 065; permissive for 040(2)(d)) are interpretations; F4 and F6 record disagreement in uncertainty handling, not established error.
Reference assigned no unit-level duty to LEAs for (e) because the source is passive; F5 could be resolved either way by a legal reader.
overall_fable_conclusion: Every source function in the frozen reference maps to at least one inventory unit, and the large majority of the 110 assertions are entailed by the quoted source text with appropriate absence statements for timezone, access details, and deadline basis. Material concerns are concentrated in the proposed rule text: deletion/addition asserted from plain-text brackets without uncertainty (94, 95), eligibility criteria and declarative-future language tagged as mandatory duties (86, 87, 102, 103, 104, 110), an inferred actor for the passive accounting duty (99), and five applicability fields that are truncated or contain non-source characters (88, 95, 96, 98, 99). Notice-side units (1 through 84) are substantively sound, with only low-severity glosses and one conflation of historical filing with amendment target (81). This is an advisory assessment; no score is given and completeness of the inventory against the source is not certified.
